title: AI engineer intern
description: Partial fit: honest about the gaps, strict about the evidence.
posting_text:
AI Engineer Intern - Lumen AI
You'll prototype LLM-powered features with our applied AI team.
Must have:
- Python
- Experience calling LLM APIs
- Understanding of AI agents and tool calling
Nice to have:
- RAG / vector databases

profile.name: Alex Example
profile.summary: Computer engineering student focused on backend and AI applications, with internship experience in QA and consulting.

bullets.text: Designed and executed functional test cases for a banking web application in an Agile team.
Tracked and triaged defects in Jira and validated data with SQL queries.
Built a FastAPI backend that scans the local network and serves device status to an HTML dashboard.
Runs as a background service with automatic restart.
Python scraper that finds flights under a price threshold and emails an HTML summary.
Scheduled weekly with GitHub Actions.

matches.note: Demonstrated through core skills and multiple Python-based projects.
Covered via the Hugging Face AI Agents Course, but lacks dedicated project or workplace experience calling LLM APIs.
Demonstrated understanding through completion of the Hugging Face AI Agents Course.
Covered as part of the Hugging Face AI Agents Course curriculum.
No mention of RAG experience in the profile.
No mention of vector database experience in the profile.

fit.summary: Alex meets the core foundational requirements for an intern, showing solid Python proficiency and foundational knowledge in AI agents and tool calling via coursework, but lacks practical experience with LLM APIs, RAG, and vector databases.

paragraphs.text: Lumen AI's focus on prototyping LLM-powered features matches my background as a computer engineering student specializing in backend and AI applications.

My development work centers on Python. I built a FastAPI backend for a home network monitor to serve device status to an HTML dashboard, and developed an automated flight scraper that processes pricing thresholds and distributes HTML summaries.
To complement my software projects, I completed Hugging Face's AI Agents Course, gaining structured knowledge in AI agents, tool calling, and LLMs.
